summary: News Corp filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) to disclose routine ASX reporting of daily share repurchases under its existing $1 billion buyback program. The filing reiterates the program's authorization and forward-looking disclaimers; no new authorization, material terms, or structural changes are provided. No price, premium, or other deal terms are stated. This is a regulatory compliance filing, not a special situation event. The market should see no risk-arb angle, as this is merely a periodic update on an ongoing capital return activity.
